info.name: EvercupPoints API
info.description:
Coffee shop loyalty membership API (NestJS + TypeORM + MySQL + JWT).

Run the whole collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner: each request saves the IDs it creates (customerId, qrCode, rewardId, transactionId, redemptionId, staffId) for the requests after it, and every request has tests for its status code. A fresh run id keeps receipts, emails and usernames unique, so it can be re-run on the same database.

Before the first run: `npm run seed` in backend (creates the admin account).

exec: // Runs after every request: errors must use the Standard Error Response format.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Login issues a JWT. Every protected route needs it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

request.description: Public. Returns the staff profile and a signed JWT. The test saves it to {{token}}, which the whole collection uses. Also starts a new run id so receipts and emails never collide with an earlier run.
Authenticated. Shows who the token belongs to.
Same message whether the username or the password is wrong, so usernames cannot be discovered.

response.name: 401 Unauthorized

request.description: No Authorization header: JwtAuthGuard rejects the request before the controller runs.

item.name: 2. Customers
item.description: Loyalty members. Registering and opening your own card are public; reading is for any staff; editing and deleting is Admin only.

request.description: Public. The server generates the customer ID, the QR member code and the starting balance of 0. Emails the QR card when MAIL_* is set in .env (reserved test domains like example.com are skipped), and reports it in cardEmailed.

item.name: 4. Point Transactions
item.description: Points earned per purchase. Create and read only: a transaction is a permanent record.

request.description: Staff or Admin. The client sends the amount; the server calculates the points (1 per 10 pesos). StaffID comes from the token, not the body.
ReceiptNumber is UNIQUE, so one purchase can never earn points twice.

response.name: 409 Conflict
400 Bad Request

item.name: 5. Redemptions
item.description: Rewards claimed with points. Create and read only.

request.description: Staff or Admin. Deducts the reward's points inside one database transaction, with the member's row locked.
The member now has 5 points and the reward needs 20.

response.name: 400 Bad Request
